claim_boundary: GO_DESIGN_RUNNER_INTEGRATION_NOT_RUN authorizes only implementation and synthetic testing of the reviewed architecture. It authorizes no real receipt, manifest, archive or metadata access; no claim, executable binding or run; no selection, Phase1, G0-G8, training, inference or research claim.

artifact_lifecycle: Publish exactly the frozen twelve names; create the self-excluded index last from streaming hashes of the first eleven.
Use exclusive writes, bounded write-all loops, stable handle/path identity, strict file and directory sync, atomic no-replace staging-to-final rename and post-publish streaming rehash.
Retain every claim, staging and final residue; never clean, overwrite, reuse or automatically recover an attempt.
Hash the up-to-two-GiB restricted seal in bounded streaming buffers and never materialize it as one Python bytes object.
binding_conditions: Bind one HEAD and exact bytes/SHA256 for runner, worker, tests, parser, watchdog, layout control, protocol and review authorities.
Bind absolute Python executable/version/hash, Windows Job policy, complete argv, minimal environment, cwd, claim/staging/final paths, deadline, buffers and output caps.
Bind the twelve exact names, empty/partial/status schemas, expected receipt/manifest/archive declarations and all three failure taxonomies.
Obtain a separate exact attempt01 execution reviewer GO before claim acquisition.
design.no_descendants: On the formal Windows platform create the worker suspended, assign an exclusive Job Object with ACTIVE_PROCESS_LIMIT=1 and KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, then resume; any containment failure is fail-closed before archive feed.
parent_worker_architecture: The trusted parent alone owns claim, input ordering, archive feed and prefix hash, watchdog, closure, index and publication.
The exact isolated worker reads only bounded compressed stdin, writes only public and restricted streaming outputs, and returns bounded path-free READY/terminal control messages.
Archive access starts only after a valid worker READY; parent and parser independently hash the same supplied compressed scan.
postclaim_allowed: Stable-read, validate and stream-copy receipt, then manifest.
Only after both pass and worker READY, stable-open and feed the archive.
Build a truthful COMPLETE or HASH_CLOSED_STOP closure and attempt atomic publication.
preclaim_allowed: Validate only HEAD-exact trusted code, tests, protocol, binding, reviewer authority, toolchain, argv, environment, cwd strings and containment configuration.
Inspect only exact claim, staging and final control paths and their parent; do not enumerate real-input directories.
Read declared input paths and expected hashes only from frozen authorities; never touch the corresponding real files.

BLOCKING_FINAL_UNVERIFIED.action: Retain final and claim without rollback, overwrite or acceptance until a separate result-blind closure review verifies exact bytes.
conditions: post-publication streaming rehash failure or mismatch

HASH_CLOSED_STOP.action: Publish the exact twelve-file closure with actual complete, partial or frozen empty-representation bytes hashed in the index and explicit inconclusive status in results.
conditions: receipt or manifest missing, invalid, partial or mismatched while the control plane remains healthy
archive absent, open failure or expected hash/size mismatch
gzip, tar, PAX, path, type, checksum, integrity, resource or privacy-policy failure
parser exception, worker nonzero or control-protocol error
contained timeout or bounded log overflow after all worker and feeder handles stabilize
observed_hash_rules: NONE uses null observed SHA256 and zero observed bytes
SUPPLIED_PREFIX uses the actual supplied-prefix SHA256 and bytes
COMPLETE_STREAM is the only state allowed to report a complete observed SHA256
expected full SHA256 is never copied into an observed field

NONPUBLISHABLE_RESIDUE.action: Retain permanent claim and all staging residue, publish no formal STOP, and require a separately reviewed attempt02.
conditions: claim durability failure or preexisting claim/staging/final
path identity, symlink, hardlink or concurrent replacement failure
feeder, control or log thread cannot terminate
worker or Job cannot be terminated
required STOP metadata or index cannot be exclusively and durably written within caps
parent crash, power loss or otherwise unconfirmed closure
